subject: [Escalation] Delta AI hosted-API supervolume rate request — exec signoff needed
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Brooks <sam.brooks@delta-ai.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API proposal for Delta AI — preliminary commercial

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the call today. Per our conversation, attached is the commercial proposal and a short forecast based on the usage profile you shared. To hit the pricing Delta asked for on average token cost, we modeled a tiered hosted-API rate with a deep upfront commitment and a 24-month billing term.

High level:
- Committed monthly usage: 60M tokens
- Proposed effective discount: 25% off list hosted-API per-token rate (volume + prepay)
- Add-on: priority capacity slot during your peak window (US-PAC 06:00–09:00 PT)

This is outside standard playbook (>20% off), so I looped Evelyn and the deal desk for exec signoff. If you can confirm the forecast in the attached sheet and agree to a 24-month commitment, we can route this for approval immediately.

Attachments: DeltaAI_MSA_redline_v3.pdf (pdf), delta-ai_usage_forecast.xlsx (xlsx)

Next steps:
1) Delta confirms committed volume and term
2) We route to Redwood execs for approval of the 25% concession
3) Sign MSA and finalize DocuSign link

Sam — any changes on your side to the numbers?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API proposal for Delta AI — preliminary commercial

Marissa —

Thanks for the packet. Looping Karthik (deal desk) for a quick economics check. A couple of ask items before I can greenlight in principle:
- Confirm uplift protections: do we have a rollback/fail-safe if their usage drops below 50% of forecast in months 3–6?
- Does the priority capacity slot carry an SLA or credits? If so, what is the cost basis?
- What is the expected gross margin at 25%? Need to be comfortable with unit economics.

I want a concise recommendation from deal desk (approve/approve-with-conditions/decline) with the math. If it's >20% we need my signoff.

Rishi
VP, Sales — Enterprise | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API proposal for Delta AI — deal desk analysis

Rishi / team —

Summary analysis (short):
- Proposed concession: 25% off list hosted-API per-token pricing (blended) with 24-month commitment and 6-month ramp guarantee.
- Expected committed ARR: ~$720k (year 1 effective), total contract value (24 months): ~$1.35M after commitments and adjustments.
- Estimated incremental unit cost to Redwood (GPU + infra + infra ops + caching) at expected profile: ~38% of list revenue.
- Projected gross margin at 25% concession: ~32% (borderline but acceptable given strategic value + potential for Dedicated conversion).

Recommended guardrails for approval:
1) 24-month firm term with early-termination fee covering 6 months of committed revenue if premature exit
2) 6-month minimum usage ramp — if usage <50% of forecast for two consecutive months after month 3, revert to 15% concession (auto-adjust)
3) Priority capacity slot provided as operational commitment, not a formal SLA with credits (we can add a single availability credit clause capped at $10k)
4) Legal to accept MSA redlines limited to data residency & KMS language only; no open indemnity expansion

Deal desk recommendation: Approve 25% concession with the guardrails above.

Attachments: delta-ai_usage_forecast.xlsx (xlsx)

-karthik
Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Exec signoff request: Delta AI — 25% hosted-API concession

Rishi —

Per Karthik's analysis, deal desk recommends approval at 25% with the guardrails he listed. Commercial notes: Delta has signaled commitment to a 24-month term and has provided PO language through procurement. I included the redlined MSA they returned — nothing material beyond our standard exceptions.

I'm routing this for your formal signoff. If you approve, I'll:
- send DocuSign envelope to Delta (link below)
- notify finance to create the special rate card and billing schedule
- have Legal insert the early-termination fee clause and the usage rollback language into the MSA

DocuSign draft: https://docusign.example.com/ENVELOPE-9f8b7a
Attachments: DeltaAI_MSA_redline_v3.pdf

Please reply with APPROVE/APPROVE-W-CONDITIONS/DECLINE and any edits.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Exec signoff request: Delta AI — 25% hosted-API concession

APPROVE-W-CONDITIONS — APPROVED (25% concession)
Conditions acknowledged and required before countersign:
- Insert 6-month ramp guardrail with auto-reversion to 15% concession as drafted by Karthik
- Include early-termination fee covering 6 months of committed revenue
- Cap operational credit for priority capacity at $10k

Once Legal confirms the two clause insertions are clean, proceed to DocuSign and notify Finance to create the special rate card. Great work getting this to closure — looks like a strategic fit.

Rishi
VP, Sales — Enterprise | Redwood Inference
